title: LinkedIn: the headline, the summary, and the noise

videos.script: In Brazil, a large share of junior hiring in IT starts on LinkedIn, and most of it starts with a recruiter typing a search. {{search}} What they see in the results is your name, one line and your city. That line decides whether they click. {{line}} Most first profiles spend it on student, passionate about technology, or seeking new opportunities. None of those is what a recruiter types. {{none}} This lesson writes the headline and the summary, and deals with the rest of LinkedIn: the posts, the badges and the advice to be active every day.
